title: Cannonball Clash
description: Naval cannon duel. Defend your fortress and sink your opponent's ship with well-aimed shots. First to 11 hits wins the sea.
keyboardControls: ArrowUp / W — move up • ArrowDown / S — move down • Space / Escape — pause • Enter — confirm
howToPlay: Defend your fortress and sink your opponent's ship with well-aimed cannon shots. First to 11 hits wins. Use the slide zone or nudge buttons to move your ship up and down. Tap START to begin each round.
tips: The AI ramps up in difficulty. Power-ups (gold glow) make your paddle bigger temporarily. Audio unlocks after your first tap.
firstPlayTip: Slide ship up/down, tap START. Easiest on touch.
bestFor: Quick first touch game — simplest controls, instant action.
availabilityNote: Playable in browser now via Pygbag and WebAssembly, and also included in the desktop release.
seoDescription: Play Cannonball Clash in your browser — a naval Pong duel with power-ups, AI opponent, and procedural audio.
demonstrates: Touch input bridge for slide controls

title: Treasure Cove
description: Smash through fort defenses to reach the loot. Each brick is a barrier between you and the treasure hoard.
keyboardControls: ArrowLeft / A — move left • ArrowRight / D — move right • Space — launch ball • Escape — pause • Enter — confirm
howToPlay: Smash through the fortress walls to reach the treasure hoard. Slide the longboat left and right to bounce the ball. Tap LAUNCH to serve. Each brick row has different durability — watch for cracks!
tips: Bricks show row-specific stone colors. The last-hit brick pulses gold. The ball speeds up over time. Lives: 3.
firstPlayTip: Slide longboat left/right, tap LAUNCH. Medium on touch.
bestFor: Classic brick-breaker fans who want a pirate twist on Breakout.
availabilityNote: Playable in browser now via Pygbag and WebAssembly, and also included in the desktop release.
seoDescription: Play Treasure Cove in your browser — a pirate Breakout brick breaker with 8 rows, score combos, and paddle power-up.

title: Kraken's Wake
description: Navigate treacherous waters and blast sea monsters. Watch for the Kraken — it hits hard.
keyboardControls: ArrowLeft / A — turn left • ArrowRight / D — turn right • ArrowUp / W — thrust • Space — fire • Escape / P — pause • Enter — confirm
howToPlay: Navigate treacherous waters and blast sea monsters. Turn your ship, thrust forward, and fire cannons to survive waves. Collect treasure pickups for bonus points. Watch for the Kraken — it hits hard!
tips: THRUST applies forward momentum; let go to coast. FIRE has a cooldown. Treasure pickups give bonus points. 3 lives per game.
firstPlayTip: Turn ship, thrust forward, fire cannons. Harder on touch.
bestFor: Asteroids veterans — momentum-based movement and wave survival.
availabilityNote: Playable in browser now via Pygbag and WebAssembly, and also included in the desktop release.
seoDescription: Play Kraken's Wake in your browser — an Asteroids-style sea monster survival game with treasure pickups and 3 lives.

title: Race to Treasure Island
description: OutRun-style pirate chase. Hold BOOST to surge past Long John, dodge obstacles that cost wind and bump you off course, and reach Treasure Island first.
keyboardControls: ArrowLeft / A — steer left • ArrowRight / D — steer right • Shift / Space — hold boost • Enter — restart • Escape / P — pause
howToPlay: Race Long John to Treasure Island in this OutRun-style pirate chase! Hold BOOST to surge ahead — your wind meter drains while boosting but recharges when you coast. Dodge barrels, shipwrecks, reefs, and debris: obstacles drain wind, bump you sideways, and briefly stun your ship. Collect treasure chests for +100 bonus points. The course speeds up as you go. Use boost strategically to overtake Long John and reach the island first.
tips: Boost strategically — steady draining beats running out at the last turn. Obstacles cost 20 wind and bump you off course. Treasure chests give +100 points. Speed increases as you progress. Long John makes occasional mistakes — time your push.
firstPlayTip: ← ▶ to steer, HOLD ⛵ to boost. Dodge everything, collect treasure, and beat Long John!
bestFor: Instant-load racing — boost management, obstacle dodging, AI rival.
availabilityNote: Phaser 3 web-native game. Loads instantly in browser — no runtime download needed.
seoDescription: Play Race to Treasure Island, Pirate Arcade's web-native Phaser 3 OutRun-style racer. Dodge obstacles, manage wind boost, and beat Long John to shore.
demonstrates: Real-time obstacle interaction (wind cost, bump, stun)

title: Port Royale Tycoon
description: Buy ports, build trade empires, and rule the seas. Outsmart rival captains and become the wealthiest pirate on the map.
keyboardControls: Mouse-driven UI • Keyboard shortcuts for actions
howToPlay: Buy ports, build trade empires, and rule the seas. Outsmart rival captains and become the wealthiest pirate on the map. 2-4 players with AI opponents.
tips: Save often. AI opponents play aggressively. Trade routes compound over time.
firstPlayTip: Start with a 2-player game to learn the mechanics.
bestFor: Turn-based strategy fans who want a deep pirate economy game.
availabilityNote: Available in the desktop release now. The Pygbag/WebAssembly pipeline proved effective for arcade games, but a turn-based board game with point-and-click controls needs a different approach. A browser version is under evaluation (see the build log for details).
seoDescription: Download Port Royale Tycoon — a pirate property-trading board game with 2-4 players, AI opponents, and save/load.
